subject: English
passage: Recycling, or reprocessing materials that would otherwise be thrown away, is a valuable environmental practice because it reduces waste in households and also helps address broader ecological problems. In a survey of adults in urban areas, most respondents said that they believe recycling is a way to reduce clutter and waste in their own homes. Meanwhile, only 8% of the adults said that they think recycling is a way to help solve environmental issues on a larger scale. These replies suggest that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: many adults think they can recycle only materials that are collected in their own neighborhoods.
choices.B: recycling can help the environment more than it can help individual households.
choices.C: recycling may be even more beneficial than many adults think it is.
choices.D: many adults may not know how to find proper recycling facilities in their area.

explanation: Choice C is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of recycling. The text asserts that recycling benefits both individual households and helps address broader ecological problems. It then states that in a survey of adults, a majority of respondents said that recycling reduces household waste, but only 8% of respondents said that recycling helps solve larger environmental issues. If recycling does in fact help address broader ecological problems, as the text says, but only 8% of adults believe it does, then it's reasonable to conclude that recycling is more beneficial than many adults think it is.
